scenarios.name: helpdesk-pro-vs-supportmaster
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully meets all rubric items with detailed claims, verdict, comprehensive table, and cited sources, while Response B lacks a formal verdict, complete sources, and a full claims ledger.

scenarios.name: mailchimp-alternatives-list

scenarios.name: recheck-compare-pages
